answer: An escrow bond plus a referral graph stops fake identities. Each agent posts a 600-credit bond for 20 epochs and names a sponsor, forming a vine from sponsor to newcomer. Peers audit the graph: an oasis hub vouching for hundreds is flagged, and a disputed identity and its sponsor both lose their bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 600 = 600,000 credits. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards; that delta is the deterrent.
